🔥 核心新招式 · 怒吼流星（大范围爆破）
🔥 Core New Move · Roaring Meteor (Large-Area Blast)
白鬃莱尼尔的标志性新技能，也是与红鬃、蓝鬃最大的不同。一味在地面跑开会被它秒杀，必须学会主动应对。

The White-Maned Lynel's signature new skill, and the biggest difference from the Red-Maned and Blue-Maned versions. Simply running away on the ground will get you killed instantly — you must learn to deal with it proactively.
🔥 招式：蓄力怒吼 + 砸地火圈
🔥 The move: charged roar + ground-slam fire ring
它会突然停在原地，高高仰头发出震耳欲聋的怒吼，随后将武器猛烈砸向地面，以它为中心引发半径巨大的圆形火焰爆炸。离得越远越难逃出去，在地面只靠奔跑几乎必被命中。

It suddenly stops in place, throws its head high back with a deafening roar, then slams its weapon violently into the ground, triggering a huge-radius circular fire explosion centered on itself. The farther away you are, the harder it is to escape — running on the ground alone will almost certainly get you hit.

✅ 方案 A（最推荐）· 蓄力时爆头打断
✅ Option A (most recommended) · Headshot during charge-up to interrupt
看到它开始仰头怒吼时，千万不要逃跑！ 它在蓄力时全身都是破绽，立刻掏出弓箭瞄准脸部射击。只要爆头成功： ① 直接打断蓄力，爆炸不会发生 ② 强行让它跪地，白送一次上马机会 → 这是把危机变成输出机会的最优解。

When you see it start to throw its head back and roar, do NOT run away! While it charges up, its whole body is exposed — immediately draw your bow and shoot it in the face. If the headshot lands: ① it directly interrupts the charge-up, so the explosion never happens; ② it forces the Lynel to kneel, handing you a free mounting opportunity → this is the optimal way to turn danger into damage.

🛡 方案 B（保险流）· 盾反吃掉冲击波
🛡 Option B (safe play) · Perfect Guard to absorb the shockwave
如果手速慢没有射中，在它砸地的一瞬间立刻举起盾牌进行盾反（Parry）。盾反可以完美吃掉爆炸的冲击波，化险为夷。 如果连盾反也错过了，只能立刻转身狂奔——此时跑不跑都很危险，所以优先练方案 A。

If your hands are too slow and you miss the shot, raise your shield and Perfect Guard the instant it slams the ground. A Perfect Guard perfectly absorbs the explosion's shockwave, turning danger into safety. If you miss the Perfect Guard too, all you can do is turn and sprint — running or not, you are in danger either way, so practice Option A first.

🗡️ 《荒野之息》打法 · 时停流与近战盾反
🗡️ Breath of the Wild Strategy · Time-Stop and Melee Perfect Guard
在《荒野之息》中，善用希卡之石的静止器升级（时停+），可以大幅简化白鬃的战斗流程：
In Breath of the Wild, good use of the Sheikah Slate's Stasis upgrade (Stasis+) can greatly simplify the White-Maned fight:
时停+（静止器升级）强制爆头： 只要人马准备冲锋或开始怒吼蓄力，立刻用时停把它定住，然后用弓箭往它脸上射一箭。时停解除后它会摇晃脑袋，等它摇完头、恢复正常的瞬间，再往脸上补一箭，它就会跪地——双箭连射稳定触发跪地。

Stasis+ (Stasis upgrade) forced headshot: the moment the Lynel prepares to charge or starts its roar charge-up, freeze it with Stasis, then shoot it in the face with your bow. After Stasis ends it shakes its head; the instant it finishes shaking and returns to normal, shoot its face again and it will kneel — two arrows in succession reliably trigger kneeling.

Bait the triple slash up close (most efficient ground damage): circle as close to it as possible to bait the triple slash. This move very easily triggers a backflip a Flurry Rush; once in slow motion, unleash damage freely — the highest-damage ground tactic. Don't wait at a distance — long range actually makes you more likely to be hurt by the roaring fire ring.

Perfect Guard follow-up loop: against its normal melee attacks, raise your shield and wait for a Perfect Guard opening. After a successful Perfect Guard you are extremely close — immediately draw your bow and blind-fire at its face for a very high hit rate, then mount for damage once it kneels.
🚀 《王国之泪》打法 · 破甲 + 空中林克时间
🚀 Tears of the Kingdom Strategy · Armor Break + Midair Bullet Time
《王国之泪》地底竞技场或部分地表的白鬃莱尼尔出场时自带岩石护甲（血条有一层黄色槽）。破甲之前，它免疫任何上马和硬直，跪地提示不会出现，必须先把黄色槽打掉：

White-Maned Lynels in the Tears of the Kingdom Depths arenas, or some on the surface, spawn wearing rock armor (a yellow bar over their health). Before the armor is broken, they are immune to mounting and to stagger, and no kneeling prompt appears — you must destroy the yellow bar first:
破甲（必备前提）： 护甲存在时上马提示不出现。给箭头附魔大炮、炸弹花，或手持融合了莱尼尔蹄子 / 各类钝器素材的双手大剑。利用盾反后的硬直，或趁它冲锋时用重武器持续砸击，直到黄色槽彻底打碎，护甲崩落。

Armor break (required first step): while the armor is present, no mount prompt appears. Fuse cannons or Bomb Flowers to your arrows, or wield a two-handed greatsword fused with a Lynel hoof / blunt materials. Use the stagger after a Perfect Guard, or keep smashing with a heavy weapon while it charges, until the yellow bar is fully destroyed and the armor falls off.

Force midair bullet time (create a damage environment): after breaking the armor, immediately use a large-capacity battery + rocket shield to fly high, or throw out a Wing and jump onto it, getting yourself airborne. Looking down on the Lynel from above puts you in the safest damage environment.

追踪箭强行爆头（无视瞄准难度）： 在空中开弓进入林克时间，给箭头附魔基斯的眼球（蝙蝠眼睛），连续射击。追踪箭会自动修正弹道，精准砸在人马脸上将其击晕——彻底跳过了手动瞄准的难题。

Homing arrows force headshots (ignoring aim difficulty): draw your bow midair to enter bullet time, fuse Keese eyeballs (bat eyes) to your arrows, and keep shooting. Homing arrows auto-correct their trajectory and land precisely on the Lynel's face to stun it — completely skipping the manual aiming problem.

近卫流骑乘带走（终结战斗）： 落地后迅速跑到它身边上马，换上压到最后 1 点耐久的「红血近卫双手剑」（伤害翻倍 + 融合高攻素材），5 刀就能蒸发大几百甚至上千血量，数轮循环可终结战斗。

Royal Guard mounted finish (end the fight): after landing, quickly run to its side and mount, switching to a "red-health Royal Guard's Claymore" worn down to its last 1 durability point (double damage + high-attack fused material). Five hits can vaporize several hundred or even over a thousand HP, and a few loops will end the fight.
